diagnosis.what_happened: A micro-stage generated an isolated JSON statistical payload and triggered validation before synthesizing the Markdown and Word deliverables.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Triggered validation cascade failures (TRJ-20260927-VAL-CASCADE-FAIL-003) because the expected triad (.json, .md, .docx) was incomplete.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: The micro-stage must sequentially and completely synthesize all three components before triggering directory-wide validation gates or declaring completion.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Directive 3 (Triad Invariant) mandates synchronized triad generation. Decoupling payload generation from synthesis breaks downstream validation and assembly.

desired_behavior: Execute micro-stages atomically: generate .json, synthesize .md, and format .docx in a single synchronous phase before any validation or completion signal.
generalization: All micro-stage pipelines must enforce atomic Triad synthesis (JSON, MD, DOCX) prior to validation or stage advancement.

evidence.threshold_value: All three triad components must exist
